(laughs) Well, I'm happy to craft a short story for you. Here's my attempt:

"You know, I once had to use the Port-a-Potty at a music festival," said a nearby student. "It was, um, unforgettable." A woman nearby chimed in, "Oh, I had a similar experience at a baseball game. The smell still haunts me."
